## Description
Include a summary of the layout improvements or page additions made. 

## Related Issue
Fixes # (issue reference code)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes a visual layout bug)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds a mockup page template)
- [ ] Refactor (code cleanup, performance optimization, file sitemap improvements)

## Validation Check
- [ ] Running `node build.js` runs without compiler errors.
- [ ] Running `node verify.js` passes with zero broken links.
- [ ] Focus outlines and ARIA indicators comply with WCAG AA parameters.
